comments.author: Hans
comments.body: Follow the walls along the right side of the maiden pass the fountain that is beside the maiden. After passing the man-made ofuntain on the right of the maiden, you will see walls with carpets and potteries set next to the wall. Walk up to the 2nd or 3rd carpet that is leaning against the wall and perform an observe to find the location. Once you found the location, you will notice that one of the blocks of the wall has exactly 12 sides as the quest mentioned. Do your search.
